items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Tacky Annie started going with Mr. Hoskins who owned the little club, Hugh Hoskins.

ctx.x: Did they know he was your stepfather?

No, they didn't know it was my stepfather. They wouldn't have done it. You know, those fellows had honor, as it went, you know, as their honor went, they had honor. But anyhow, there was Lumsie, Big Harry, Little Harry, and there was another fellow there, a fellow named Montgomery. Can't think of his first name. Sam Montgomery. Now, he was a pimp. So every night they would come up and the girls would check in to see which one brought in the most money, and Tacky Annie always came first. And incidentally, Tacky…
wallets, where she'd stolen money from everybody.
